subject: Billing smoothing & accelerated implementation - change order and legal evidence request
messages:
From: Sasha Patel <sasha@lumenx.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: LumenX Procurement <procurement@lumenx.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: accelerate implementation + billing smoothing (SOW/Order Form)

Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Weʼre ready to push the integration earlier than planned (targeting go-live 2026-05-15). Two asks from procurement/finance:

- Can we smooth billing so the implementation fee is amortized across months 1–3 instead of a single upfront invoice?
- Weʼll need a short change order that adds the extra capacity buffer during the first 90 days (burst pool + 20% baseline).

I attached the proposed SOW edits (see LumenX_SOW_v2.docx) — those are internal to us but wanted to surface the request so you can route to legal. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Sasha
Sasha Patel
Head of Platform Partnerships
LumenX
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Patel <sasha@lumenx.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: accelerate implementation + billing smoothing (SOW/Order Form)

Sasha —

Appreciate the heads up and congrats on the accelerated timeline. Quick plan from our side:

1) Commercial change order: we can draft a one-page change order (add capacity + amortized implementation fee) and route to your procurement for countersign. Will include an exhibit that defines the 90-day burst pool and the 20% baseline uplift.
2) Legal evidence: Jonas – can you review the SOW attachment and flag any MSA-orderform cross-references that need explicit language (pricing ladder, rollback triggers, acceptance criteria)?
3) Ops handoff: David – scheduling note: if they go-live 2026-05-15 we need a provisioning window 5/8–5/12 and a short runbook for burst scaling.

Sasha — Iʼll circulate the draft CO today and include the amortization table for finance. Expect a DocuSign link once legal signs off.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sasha Patel <sasha@lumenx.com>
Cc: david_kim <david@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: accelerate implementation + billing smoothing (SOW/Order Form)

Marissa / Sasha —

Quick read of the attached SOW. A few legal notes before we draft the CO:

- MSA cross-ref: current MSA (Exhibit A) defines throughput tiers. We should add a short clause in the CO that explicitly supersedes Exhibit A for the 90-day window and reverts to the original tiers after day 91 to avoid ambiguity.
- Acceptance criteria: SOW currently references a 30-day acceptance window. Recommend keeping that but adding a rollback trigger if average latency > SLA for two consecutive weeks during the burst period.
- Billing language: procurement asked for amortization. We can add an invoice schedule (3 equal invoices due net 30) but keep the billing credit/true-up clause for usage overage.

I attached a redline PDF with inline comments (redlines_msa_comments.pdf). Iʼll prepare a short CO template (1 page + exhibit) and send for commercial review.

Jonas Weber
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: david_kim <david@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Patel <sasha@lumenx.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Apr 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: accelerate implementation + billing smoothing (SOW/Order Form)

Sasha —

Operational checklist for the accelerated cutover:
- Provisioning slot: 2026-05-08 02:00–06:00 UTC (weʼll confirm host region).
- Burst pool sizing: pre-provision +20% baseline for 90 days — Iʼll reserve capacity and tag it to LumenX.
- Runbook: we need a signed CO that includes acceptance criteria to trigger automatic burst scaling; otherwise manual intervention will be required by on-call.

Next steps for signatures: Jonas will circulate the one-page CO with the exhibit; once countersigned weʼll deploy the change and Iʼll share the provisioning confirmation + DRT runbook. Sasha — could you confirm who will be the signer on your side (name + email) so I can pre-fill DocuSign?

Thanks,
David Kim
Head of Technical Ops, Redwood Inference
